name: Portree
method: tidetimes.org.uk Portree vs its own Ullapool (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Ullapool: median time difference, least-squares height fit
note: HW and LW heights each = offset + scale * Ullapool. tidetimes' Portree is Ullapool moved 25 min to the minute, so times are as good as Ullapool's. Heights follow tidetimes, Ullapool's Z0 is set to UKHO's level. Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Portree vs Ullapool, 2025-10-01 to 2026-11-22 (every 3 day(s), 548 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
